title: Политика назначения ролей и privilege ceiling
goal: Разделить просмотр, назначение, изменение определений и privileged access без сравнения несопоставимых scopes.
implementation_notes: apps.accounts owns role/capability catalog composition and assignment policy; domains retain enforcement.
Add validated $administration.role_assignment_allowlist mapping actor role to target roles.
Critical-effective roles absent from normal allowlist and superuser-only.
Active superuser assigns any existing contract role to another user or self; self-assignment always requires risk confirmation and audit.
Self-assignment exception does not cover technical groups, direct permissions, is_active or own is_superuser; role definitions remain superuser-only.
Recommended initial manager allowlist is customer and technician; owner approves exact values.
acceptance_checks: Manager can assign only approved standard roles.
Manager cannot assign manager/admin/doctor to self or others unless explicitly and safely approved.
Critical role cannot appear in non-superuser allowlist.
Active superuser can self-assign an existing contract role only through signed preview/apply with a dedicated risk marker.
Schema rejects unknown actor/target role codes.
independent_review: Independent privilege-escalation analysis and role/target matrix.
